'''Marblewood Estate''' was the home of [[Black Sun sector chief|Black Sun Sector Chief]] [[Avrak Villachor]]. The estate initially served as the home of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] sector [[Governor/Legends|governor]] before being sold to others. Eventually, it came into the hands of Avrak Villachor. It was located inside a large park that was surrounded by heavy [[Marblewood security force|security]]. The mansion was built in the classical [[High Empress Teta style]] and was in the shape of an [[Aurek/Legends|Aurek]].<ref name="Scoundrels" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the estate was heavily damaged during a [[Marblewood Estate heist|heist]].<ref name="Scoundrels" />
